description: Six Schmitt trigger line drivers, turning analog signals into clean digital ones.

params.text: Sets the midpoint of the input range for that driver, -10V to +10V; an input above it reads high and an input below it reads low.
Sets the hysteresis of that driver's Schmitt trigger, 0V to 5V, applied both above and below the cutoff; at 0V there is no hysteresis.

inputs.text: The analog signal that driver turns into a clean digital signal.

outputs.text: Carries the high or the low value of the digital voltage range, following the input into that driver through its cutoff and hysteresis.

menu: Input Range — a submenu of Cutoff 5V, Cutoff 0V, Cutoff 2.5V and TTL Levels, each of which sets the cutoff and the width knob of every driver in the module at once.
Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
